special_situations.summary: Promoter group discloses further large share pledges/encumbrances under SAST regs post-IPO.
special_situations.impact: Qualitative: part of a series where promoter entities have pledged/encumbered ~21.78-28% of total share capital to secure ₹9,420 Cr of NCDs and term loans.
special_situations.risk: Large promoter leverage just after listing; default could trigger forced sale/control change.
special_situations.view_reasoning: Stock trades at PE ~170, PB ~100; heavy promoter pledging so soon post-IPO is a governance red flag.

special_situations.headline: Scheme of Amalgamation approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held today, i.e. August 04, 2026.
special_situations.summary: Board approves amalgamation of 99%-owned subsidiary Minda Onkyo India into itself.
special_situations.impact: No cash consideration; pure share-swap (6 shares of ₹2 for every 10,000 MOIPL shares), completes JV wind-down after partner's bankruptcy.
special_situations.risk: Integration/regulatory delays in NCLT and shareholder approvals.
special_situations.view_reasoning: Housekeeping merger post-JV bankruptcy; company itself posting strong 26% YoY revenue growth in Q1 FY27.

special_situations.headline: The Board at its meeting held on July 31, 2026 has approved various matters and terms of the Rights Issue
special_situations.summary: Board approved terms of ₹99.83 Cr rights issue at ₹215/share to fund capacity expansion.
special_situations.impact: ~5% of FY26 revenue (₹99.83 Cr raise vs ₹2,018.71 Cr FY26 revenue); funds capacity expansion to ~7,900 kg/year from current levels.
special_situations.risk: Dilution; rising debtor days and inventory funded partly by debt.
special_situations.view_reasoning: FY26 revenue up 82%, PAT up 159%; rights issue funds a nearly 3x capacity expansion for growth.

special_situations.headline: Intimation of Fixing "Record Date" relating to reduction of Share Capital of Company under the Order of Honble National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad pursuant to Resolution Plan Approved ....
special_situations.summary: Record date fixed for capital reduction (250:1) under NCLT-approved resolution plan.
special_situations.impact: Qualitative: implementation step of revival plan with new promoters; total settlement reported around ₹4.33 Cr and authorized capital raised to ₹15.20 Cr.
special_situations.risk: Execution risk of turnaround; company still loss-making (~₹87.57 lakh FY26 loss).
special_situations.view_reasoning: Speculative distress turnaround; NCLT nod reduces liquidation risk but viability unproven.

special_situations.headline: Fixation of Record date pursuant to Scheme of Arrangement
special_situations.summary: Record date fixed for shares of demerged Inox Renewable Solutions under Scheme of Arrangement.
special_situations.impact: Shareholders receive 122 IRSL shares per 1,000 held; part of a broader restructuring alongside a proposed ₹600 Cr fundraise.
special_situations.risk: Value of new entity IRSL is unproven; concurrent large RPT/fundraise adds complexity.
special_situations.view_reasoning: Demerger already effective; near-term also has ₹600 Cr fundraise EGM and ₹500 Cr RPT with Inox Wind to track.

special_situations.headline: Please find attached herewith Notice of Court convened meeting of Unsecured Creditors of the Company to be held on Saturday, September 12, 2026 at 12:30 p.m. as per the Order of NCLT Ahmedabad.
special_situations.summary: NCLT-directed court-convened meetings of shareholders/creditors for Enertech amalgamation into IRM Energy.
special_situations.impact: Share-swap merger (Enertech holds 21.12% of IRM Energy); simplifies shareholding, no cash outlay disclosed.
special_situations.risk: Approval risk at meetings/NCLT; related-party nature of transferor holding stake in transferee.
special_situations.view_reasoning: Reasonably valued gas utility (PE ~16-21); merger simplifies structure but is largely procedural, not a growth trigger.
